description: Use this when the user wants to sign a PDF, fill in a signature line, find where to sign, or add initials or a date to a PDF form or contract. It reads the PDF's text positions and lists each place labelled Signature, Sign here, Signed, Initials, Date or Name, each blank ____ line, and each empty signature form field, with page, x, y (points from the top-left as displayed), width and a spot id for sign_pdf. Makes no file. Up to 15 MB; the first 50 pages are searched. Does not read scanned PDFs without a text layer (then give page and position to sign_pdf). Do not use for reading or summarizing a contract.

file.description: The PDF to look in, e.g. contract.pdf.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

name: find_signature_spots
title: Find signature spots

description: Use this when the user wants to sign a PDF, e-sign a document, add a signature, initials or a date to a PDF, or put their name on a signature line. It draws a visible mark on a copy of the user's PDF at found spots (ids from find_signature_spots) or at a page and position: a drawn signature (SVG path from the widget pad) or a typed name in an italic font, initials, a date in the chosen format from the user's date, or short text. It returns the signed copy as a download kept for about 1 hour and checks that each mark is in the file. It is not a certified digital signature: no certificate, identity check or audit trail. Does not fill form fields with data and does not send the document to anyone. Do not use for certificate-based digital signatures or for signing on someone else's behalf without their consent.

date.description: The signing date in the user's own calendar, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11-04. Default: today in time_zone.

date_format.description: How the date is printed, e.g. MM/DD/YYYY (default).

file.description: The PDF to sign, e.g. lease.pdf.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

flatten_form.description: true: also flatten the PDF's form fields so their current values print as page content. Default false.

initials.description: Initials to use, e.g. JD. Default: first letters of signer_name.

output_name.description: File name for the signed copy, e.g. lease-signed. Default: the original name plus -signed.

placements.description: Where to put each mark, e.g. [{"spot":"s1","kind":"signature"},{"spot":"s2","kind":"date"}].

height.description: Height of the mark in points, e.g. 30. Default 30 for a signature, 14 otherwise.

page.description: 1-based page number when no spot is given, e.g. 1.

spot.description: A spot id from find_signature_spots, e.g. s2. Use this or page + x + y.

value.description: Text for kind text (up to 200 characters, e.g. Jane Doe), a YYYY-MM-DD date for kind date, or initials for kind initials (up to 8, e.g. JD).

width.description: Room for the mark in points, e.g. 180. Default: the spot width, else 180 for a signature.

x.description: Left edge of the mark in points from the page's left edge as displayed, e.g. 72.

y.description: Baseline of the mark in points from the page's top edge as displayed, e.g. 700.

signature_svg.description: A drawn signature as SVG path data with absolute M, L, C, Q, Z only (max 20 KB), e.g. M10 40 C20 10 40 10 50 40. The widget pad sends this.

signer_name.description: The signer's name, up to 80 characters, e.g. Jane Doe. Typed signatures are drawn in an italic font; also used for initials.

time_zone.description: The user's IANA time zone for today's date when no date is given, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Default America/New_York.

name: sign_pdf
title: Sign a PDF
